items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He wanted to record Billy and our band out there on that label.

ctx.x: So how did it come about that there was that recording? Did somebody come along and say, “Hey I want to record you guys or was there…”
No, you know there was this guy and his name was David Usher. And he had a—he was a good friend of Dizzy. And as a matter of fact Dizzy had a label called D.G.
Remember that yellow label? He wanted to record Billy and our band out there on that label. That’s what happened.
